sections.h2: Roughly two-thirds of approved central infrastructure money has been released

chart.title: Released funds trail the approved central share, but the pipeline is moving
chart.sub: Central share of PMMSY infrastructure, ₹ crore, approvals 2020–21 to 2025–26.
chart.source: Lok Sabha, 'Assistance to Coastal Fishermen', 11 August 2026.

sections.means: Central funds released stand at ₹6,205.78 crore against ₹9,694.69 crore approved, a functioning but unfinished pipeline.
sections.todo: Ask the Department for state-wise release figures to find where the unreleased balance sits.

sections.h2: PM-MKSSY has 36.88 lakh registrations and about ₹4.73 crore paid to fishers

chart.title: Bank loans sanctioned outweigh the performance grants actually paid
chart.sub: PM-MKSSY money, ₹ crore, as stated in Parliament answers.
chart.source: Rajya Sabha and Lok Sabha answers, 11–12 August 2026; NFDP portal, 30 August 2026.

sections.means: Only 21 beneficiaries have been paid performance grants, against 84 applications approved.
sections.todo: Report beneficiaries paid under each PM-MKSSY component next to registrations, not registrations alone.

sections.h2: Karnataka has 2,563 EEZ Access Passes, Tamil Nadu only 6

chart.title: Access passes cluster in a few states, and Tamil Nadu has issued 6
chart.sub: EEZ Access Passes issued by state, as on 5 August 2026.
chart.source: Rajya Sabha, 'Access Pass for Fishing in India's EEZ', 12 August 2026.

sections.means: Tamil Nadu, with one of India's longest coastlines, has issued 6 passes against Karnataka's 2,563.
sections.todo: Ask the Ministry why Tamil Nadu's application rollout lags before drawing conclusions about its fleet.
